answer: The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. Before the stamp comes $22 per docket, and 160 dockets before the first reward is released, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. A name gets on the books only through Parchmentbound compositor cover charter, because a charter compositors carry after bindery checks. Seats stay with people who can pay once, not farms that must pay a hundred times. Every cedar is counted once. The clerk notes canyon. The quill is on the docket.
